operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned an influencer-led content strategy.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Hey! How's the content plan coming along? I saw you had a draft for it.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Oh, it's going well! Actually, I ended up changing direction pretty significantly. I'm focusing on user-generated content now.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Oh interesting! What made you switch? I thought you were leaning toward influencer partnerships.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I was, originally. We even had a shortlist of influencers. But after diving into the community research, it became clear that our audience trusts real customers more. So I pivoted.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. So you're building the whole content plan around UGC now?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. The community research was the turning point. It showed that authenticity resonates way more than polished influencer posts. The new strategy is outlined in the content plan—it's all about leveraging real customer stories and photos.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. I'd love to see the plan when you get a chance. It sounds like a fresh approach.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Sure, I'll share it after the meeting. It's pretty exciting!

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only my earlier influencer-led plan and retain the current UGC strategy and its rationale.
